cases.contract: Implement set_left_most_unset_bit(n) for nonnegative integers. Set the most significant zero bit WITHIN the existing binary width. If every bit is one, return n unchanged. For zero return zero.
cases.application:
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(10)==14
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(15)==15
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(0)==0
cases.hidden:
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(12)==14
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(31)==31
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(32)==48

cases.contract: Implement get_ludic(n) for nonnegative integers. Return ludic numbers <=n: start with list 1..n. Keep 1. Starting at index 1, let k be that element; delete every kth subsequent element, first at index index+k, counting in the list BEFORE this deletion pass. Advance index by one and repeat until past the remaining list. For n=0 return [].
cases.application:
assert get_ludic(0)==[]
assert get_ludic(1)==[1]
assert get_ludic(10)==[1,2,3,5,7]

repair: one same-model repair after application failure only
